wish: someone should make a running app that shows your progress in terms of popular foods
spec:
Turns a run (distance and body weight) into calories burned, shown as counts of donuts, pizza slices, burgers and other common foods.
Enter distance and weight in km/kg or mi/lb; the donut count updates as you type, and you can log runs to keep a running total.
It does not track routes, pace or heart rate, and the calorie figure is an estimate.
